_comment: Sandbox trial (2026-08-26): Bash commands run inside bubblewrap with writes confined to this repo, /tmp and the listed caches, and network limited to the listed hosts. Needs `sudo apt-get install socat` on Linux; until then Claude Code warns and runs unsandboxed (failIfUnavailable is off on purpose). New hosts prompt (auto mode: classifier). The dev server is excluded so the browser can reach it. Every unsandboxed retry prompts via the ask rule, so the trial shows exactly what the sandbox would have blocked.
